name: Emergency services
summary: Call 911 when someone is in immediate danger or has a life-threatening medical emergency.
eligibility: Immediate threat to life or safety.
document_alternatives: Do not wait for documents in an emergency.
source_label: Virginia Department of Emergency Management — 911 guidance
source_excerpt: Call 911 for an immediate threat to life or safety.
why_template: You selected {needs}. Immediate safety comes before applications or paperwork.

name: Virginia 211 live navigator
summary: A live specialist can identify nearby shelter, food, transportation, health, and recovery resources.
eligibility: Anyone in Virginia seeking community services can contact 211.
document_alternatives: No document upload is required to ask for help.
source_excerpt: 211 Virginia connects people with community services through a live specialist.
why_template: A live navigator can help with {needs} and check what is open near you.

name: FEMA Individual Assistance
summary: FEMA may help eligible households with temporary housing and serious disaster-related needs not covered by insurance.
eligibility: Your area must be included in a presidential disaster declaration for Individual Assistance. Losses must be disaster-related and not fully covered by insurance.
documents: Bank information only if you choose direct deposit
document_alternatives: Start even if documents were lost. Tell FEMA what is missing and ask which alternatives are accepted; never send originals.
source_excerpt: FEMA Individual Assistance may support eligible disaster-related housing and other serious needs.
why_template: You selected {needs}. FEMA may help only when this event and location have an Individual Assistance declaration.

name: Disaster SNAP (D-SNAP)
agency: Virginia Department of Social Services / USDA FNS
summary: D-SNAP can provide short-term food benefits after a disaster when the program is activated for an affected area.
eligibility: The state must activate D-SNAP for your area. Disaster income, expenses, and available resources are considered for a specific period.
document_alternatives: Ask the local department which identity alternatives it accepts if documents were lost.
source_label: USDA Food and Nutrition Service — D-SNAP
source_excerpt: D-SNAP is available only after a state requests and receives federal approval for an affected area.
why_template: You selected {needs}. D-SNAP may help if Virginia activates it for your area.

name: SBA disaster loans
summary: Low-interest federal disaster loans may help homeowners, renters, businesses, and nonprofits repair or replace disaster-damaged property.
eligibility: The location and disaster must be declared for SBA assistance. Credit and repayment requirements apply.
document_alternatives: Ask SBA what can be supplied later. Never pay someone to guarantee approval.
source_label: U.S. Small Business Administration — Disaster Assistance
source_excerpt: SBA disaster assistance may provide loans for eligible uninsured disaster losses.
why_template: You selected {needs}. An SBA loan may cover eligible uninsured physical losses, but it must be repaid.

name: Disaster Unemployment Assistance
agency: Virginia Employment Commission / U.S. Department of Labor
summary: Temporary benefits may be available when a major disaster directly prevents work and regular unemployment benefits are unavailable.
eligibility: The President must declare a major disaster and authorize DUA. The disaster must directly cause the unemployment or work interruption.
document_alternatives: File within the announced deadline even if some work records are missing, and ask what may be supplied later.
source_label: U.S. Department of Labor — Disaster Unemployment Assistance
source_excerpt: Disaster Unemployment Assistance may be authorized after a major disaster directly interrupts work.
why_template: You selected {needs}. DUA may fit if the disaster directly stopped your work and the program is activated.

name: Replace lost identification and records
summary: Use official replacement channels for Social Security cards, state IDs, vital records, passports, and other documents.
eligibility: Replacement rules depend on the document and issuing agency.
documents: A safe mailing address if available
document_alternatives: Start with the issuing agency. Do not upload identity documents to this navigator.
source_label: USA.gov — Replace lost or stolen ID cards
source_excerpt: USA.gov routes people to the issuing agency for replacement identity and vital documents.
why_template: You indicated missing documents. This official guide shows the correct issuing agency without asking you to upload anything here.

name: Disaster Distress Helpline
summary: Free, confidential crisis counseling and support is available for distress caused by natural or human-caused disasters.
eligibility: Available to anyone experiencing disaster-related emotional distress.
document_alternatives: No application documents are required to call or text.
source_excerpt: The Disaster Distress Helpline offers disaster-related crisis counseling and support.
why_template: You selected {needs}. This service supports disaster-related distress without an eligibility application.

name: Disaster legal help
summary: Civil legal aid may help eligible survivors with housing, benefits, insurance, replacement documents, and disaster scams.
eligibility: Income and case-type rules vary by legal aid organization.
documents: Lease or insurance information if available
A short timeline of what happened
document_alternatives: Call even if records were lost. A legal aid provider can explain what else may work.
source_label: Legal Services Corporation — Find Legal Aid
source_excerpt: Legal Services Corporation helps people locate civil legal aid providers.
why_template: You selected {needs}. A civil legal aid organization may help with disaster-related disputes or deadlines.

name: Find an open emergency shelter
summary: Local officials and 211 provide current shelter locations; shelter status can change quickly.
eligibility: Openings and intake rules vary by shelter.
documents: Bring medications and identification if safely available
Do not delay leaving to collect documents
document_alternatives: Tell the shelter what you lost. Ask 211 about accessible and pet-accommodating locations.
source_excerpt: Shelter locations and intake conditions can change; confirm them with local officials or 211.
why_template: You selected {needs}. Shelter availability is time-sensitive, so confirm the location with local officials or 211 before traveling.
